subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should OpenClaw accept #102189's prompt-cache stability contract for room-event turns and Responses transports?
rationale: The remaining choice is not whether the source repro exists, but whether maintainers want ambient room_event prompts to use a stable prompt-facing delivery/tool inventory while keeping effective delivery and explicit owner-only execution strict.

options.title: Accept #102189's contract
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR's stable prompt-facing mode, safe ambient owner-only inventory, and compatible Responses suffix split after final review proof.

options.title: Revise the policy shape
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to preserve current sender-specific inventory or use a narrower documented stability boundary.

options.title: Reject runtime stabilization
options.body: Close or narrow the issue only if maintainers intentionally accept the cache cost and document the current room_event/Codex behavior instead.

recommendation.title: Accept #102189's contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR's stable prompt-facing mode, safe ambient owner-only inventory, and compatible Responses suffix split after final review proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest feature-history owner for the current group visible-reply and room-event policy family.
